vibe: Approachable, creator-friendly, tactile, polished, SaaS-quality without the enterprise sterility.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Negative Space
spacing_and_layout.containers: p-8 or p-12 internal padding for containers with borders
spacing_and_layout.grid_mode: Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris for Landing, Control Room for Dashboard)
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl for large surfaces, rounded-xl for inner cards to create a soft, tactile clay-like feel
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Soft diffuse ambient shadows tinted earthy: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(27,59,54,0.06)]

component_strategies.general: Solid warmth surfaces. Subtle rounded corners. Avoid 'glassmorphism' on dashboards to retain organic solidity. Use glass only on the marketing sticky header.
component_strategies.buttons: Primary: #1B3B36 background, #F9F8F6 text. Secondary/Destructive: #C65D47 background. Hover: Add a slight `-translate-y-0.5` lift and slightly lighter hue. High contrast focus rings.
component_strategies.cards: Flat background (#FFFFFF or tinted earthy off-white), 1px subtle border (#EAE6DF), no shadow by default. On hover: subtle lift and soft ambient shadow.
component_strategies.badges: Tiny, uppercase, wide tracking, pill-shaped (rounded-full). Colors derived from accents (Sage, Ochre, Terracotta).

pages.landing: Asymmetrical bento grids, overlapping elements. Use the hero background image with a light fade. 'Editorial ribbon' marquee (slow, organic) for integrations/features.
pages.dashboard: Control room grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Dense but clear with tight gaps (gap-6). Persistent sidebar navigation.
pages.companion_builder: Form sections using Shadcn UI but customized to the earthy palette. Use soft rounded inputs, clear label hierarchy, and left-aligned text.
pages.chat_playground: Two-pane layout. Companion selector on left, chat stream on right. Chat bubbles should be soft and asymmetrical (rounded-tl-sm for incoming, rounded-tr-sm for outgoing).
pages.templates_explore: Large colorful cards using the accented earthy colors (Sage, Ochre, Terracotta backgrounds) with the 3D claymation images.
pages.integrations: Grid of small utility cards with status badges. Clean, functional, and easily scannable.
pages.settings: Standard vertical list/form layout. Left-aligned form labels with generous spacing between sections.

hero_background.description: Abstract organic shapes in earthy tones, soft matte 3D render, clay texture.

template_creative.description: Soft 3D render of an antique typewriter made of matte sage green clay.

template_rpg.description: Soft 3D render of tabletop RPG dice made of matte terracotta clay.

template_business.description: Soft 3D render of a briefcase and coffee cup made of matte ochre clay.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
